005package org.wpilib.romi;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice.Direction;
009import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDouble;
010import org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorController;
011
012/**
013 * RomiMotor.
014 *
015 * <p>A SimDevice based motor controller representing the motors on a Romi robot
016 *
017 * <p>This class is provided by the Romi VendorDep
018 */
019public class RomiMotor implements MotorController {
020  private final SimDouble m_simSpeed;
021  private boolean m_inverted;
022
023  /**
024   * Constructor.
025   *
026   * @param channel The PWM channel that the RomiMotor is attached to. 0 is the left motor, 1 is the
027   *     right.
028   */
029  public RomiMotor(int channel) {
030    OnBoardIO.allocatePWM(channel);
031
032    // We want this to appear on the WS messages as type: "PWM", device: <channel>
033    String simDeviceName = "PWM:" + channel;
034    SimDevice romiMotorSimDevice = SimDevice.create(simDeviceName);
035
036    if (romiMotorSimDevice != null) {
037      romiMotorSimDevice.createBoolean("init", Direction.OUTPUT, true);
038      m_simSpeed = romiMotorSimDevice.createDouble("speed", Direction.OUTPUT, 0.0);
039    } else {
040      m_simSpeed = null;
041    }
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  public void setThrottle(double throttle) {
046    if (m_simSpeed != null) {
047      m_simSpeed.set(m_inverted ? -throttle : throttle);
048    }
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  public double getThrottle() {
053    if (m_simSpeed != null) {
054      return m_simSpeed.get();
055    }
056
057    return 0.0;
058  }
059
060  @Override
061  public void setInverted(boolean isInverted) {
062    m_inverted = isInverted;
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  public boolean getInverted() {
067    return m_inverted;
068  }
069}
